messages: Rory: Quick UX/accessibility note from the rollout scrubber QA. Keyboard users tab to the timeline scrubber and when a snapshot is focused, VoiceOver announces the snapshot and then the variant pill label, so it sounds duplicated: 'Snapshot June 3rd 14:10. Canary 15%. Snapshot June 3rd 14:10.' :confused: Ivy: Repro on macOS Safari. Looks like the focused snapshot has an aria-label and the pill has an aria-live update. They both fire on focus. Marta: NVDA didn't double-announce for me, so probably VoiceOver ordering again. Could be aria-live+focus announcing the same string. Kai: Two small fixes: 1) change the pill's live region to only update on allocation changes (not on focus), 2) make the snapshot focusable with aria-describedby that references a single sr-only live region for screen readers. ProductAsh: Microcopy question: the rollback modal primary CTA is "Confirm rollback". Can we make it explicit: "Rollback to snapshot"? Also screen reader should include the snapshot id in the button aria-label. Rory: Agree on explicit CTA. For the scrubber announce de-dupe, a quick patch could be: ``` Snapshot selected: 2025-06-03 14:10 UTC ``` Kai: Good approach. Put behind feature flag and include VoiceOver + NVDA manual test steps. Also add an automated accessibility test asserting only the scrubber announces on focus. Marta: Accessibility nit: focus ring for tiny variant pills disappears in high-contrast mode. Need a 2px token-based ring and visible focus-visible style. Ivy: I'll open a PR bundling: 1) move scrubber announces to a single sr-only region, 2) change rollback CTA text + aria-label to include snapshot id, 3) focus ring fix for tiny pills. Assigning @Kai to ensure feature flag and tests. DevBot: Accessibility scan queued: AR-UX-2026-88 duplicate-announcement (severity: medium). Rory: Please add a short QA checklist in the PR for VoiceOver + NVDA steps. I'll validate VoiceOver when the flag is live. Ivy: ETA PR tomorrow morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: Focus on timeline scrubber duplicate announce, explicit rollback CTA copy, accessibility fixes, feature-flagged PR plan. Unique filename and wording per agents.md.
